title: drive's host is a long LLM session whose context re-reads cost more than the builders; run each phase/escalation from a fresh session or a plain shell
detail: Measured 2026-11-18 (observed-writes attempt 1): cost by role main $12.57 vs backend-builder $7.52 + test-writer $4.46; cache reads $11.69 of $31.34. drive is deterministic Python and already spawns each role headless and fresh; the expensive term is the operator's Claude session hosting it across phases. Expected: drive is started and resumed from a plain shell (no LLM host), each escalation is a self-contained file a fresh session can pick up, and the hand-off is the default path, not only when session_budget_usd trips. Operator direction: 'why not each stage be run as a next session'.
